task.title: Installing StreamForge Mobile
task.shortdesc: Install the StreamForge Mobile companion app on iOS or Android.

step.cmd: Open the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android) on your phone.
Search for StreamForge Mobile and install it.
Open the app and sign in with your StreamForge account.

taskbody.result: StreamForge Mobile opens to a pairing screen, ready to connect to a desktop product on the same network.
